raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On a 1P2D NIXL deployment (LIBFABRIC backend over EFA, SGLang `a6a8c560` with local patches) the prefill lost ~300 requests/hour to `KVPoll.WaitingForInput` timeouts on the decode side while the decode engines restarted repeatedly (a separate CUDA fault). The prefill never logged a NIXL transport error. It logged ~2000/hour `Peer <agent> was already registered, ignoring.`

Two gaps in `NixlKVManager` on the prefill:

- A decode that restarts registers a new agent name from the same ip and rank port. The prefill keeps the old agent's metadata, its transport endpoint and every room promised to it. Nothing fails those rooms until the decode's waiting timeout.
- A decode that timed out on this prefill rank drops its cached bootstrap info and registers again under the same agent name (`_check_waiting_timeout` -> `invalidate_cached_bootstrap_infos` -> `_register_kv_args`). The prefill ignores that registration, so the endpoint the decode timed out on is reused for its next room.

#41691 reloads a peer only when NIXL itself marks its metadata invalid. A transport error on a posted handle does not always do that, so the dead endpoint outlives every retry.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/nixl/conn.py`:

- `_add_remote_peer` indexes peers by `_peer_identity` = `(endpoint, gpu_id, decode_tp_rank, dst_dcp_rank)`. The decode's rank port comes from `get_zmq_socket_on_host` (`bind_to_random_port`, so a new port per process) and its agent name is a fresh uuid, so neither identifies the process across a restart; the second commit replaces the port-based key of the first. A new agent name for a known identity means the decode process restarted: `_evict_replaced_peer` drops the old agent's NIXL metadata and dlists, flags it evicted (its registration stays in the table so a late chunk still referencing it fails through the normal not-found path), and fails its unconcluded rooms with `record_failure` + `KVPoll.Failed`, so the prefill frees their KV instead of waiting out the decode's timeout.
- A registration under an already known agent name is queued in `_peer_refresh_pending`. The transfer worker applies it before posting the next room for that peer (`_refresh_reregistered_peers`): drop and reload the remote agent, which rebuilds the transport endpoint, then rebuild the dlists. Done on the worker because it is the only thread holding the peer's dlists; throttled per peer by the existing `_PEER_RELOAD_MIN_INTERVAL_S`.
- `_reload_invalidated_peers` takes the failure: a transport error that names a peer forces that peer's rebuild even while `check_remote_metadata` is true. Peers the error does not name keep the invalidation-only behaviour, so a healthy sibling in the room is never rebuilt.
- `_rebuild_peer` is the shared drop / reload / `_prepare_payload_xfer` / `_prepare_state_xfer` step; `_peer_registry` lazily creates the bookkeeping for managers built without `__init__` (the existing test rigs).

Successful registration and transfer paths are unchanged; the new work runs on re-registration, on a replaced endpoint, and after a transfer failure.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model forward or sampling. As a check that the KV transfer path is intact, sgl-eval against the 1P2D EFA deployment carrying this patch (Kimi K3, thinking on, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, 32 threads, with live shadow traffic alongside): GSM8K 1319/1319 answered, score 0.9735, 0 errors, 0 truncations; AIME26 x4 (30 problems, max_tokens 65536): pass@1 0.908 ± 0.028, majority@4 1.0, pass@4 1.0, 0 errors, 3/120 samples truncated at the 65,536-token cap.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the new code runs only on peer re-registration, eviction and after a failed transfer.

## Validation

- **CPU unit tests** (`test/registered/unit/disaggregation`): `test_nixl_backend_basic` 31/31 (main: 27/27; 4 new tests in `TestNixlInvalidatedPeerReload`: a restarted decode evicts the old peer and fails its rooms, distinct endpoints never evict each other, a re-registered peer is rebuilt by the worker before posting, a transport error rebuilds only the peer it names); `test_nixl_deferred_kv_release` 6/6.
- **Serving:** the first revision of this change (port-keyed, first commit) ran as a candidate deployment of the affected 1P2D EFA arm on real shadow traffic for two days without NIXL errors. Two decode restarts (CUDA illegal memory access, unrelated) happened on 2026-11-03: the restarted decodes re-registered under new agent names and served again, with no `WaitingForInput` timeouts or 5xx in the window, but the port-keyed eviction never matched the replaced agent, which is what the second commit fixes. A deployment with the second commit and a decode-kill run are pending; I will post them here.
- **Formatting:** isort, ruff (`F401,F821,F823,UP037`), ruff-format, codespell and `git diff --check` pass.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
Decode-restart run on the 1P2D EFA deployment (LIBFABRIC backend, shadow traffic) carrying this patch with the GPU-rank-keyed identity:

**Container restart, same ip** (both decode engines died within two minutes of each other, a separate scheduler crash):
- The prefill logged 32 `NIXL peer … was replaced by …; evicting it and failing its rooms` lines when the restarted decodes registered after loading (8 GPUs × 2 prefill ranks × 2 decodes).
- 0 `WaitingForInput` timeouts, 0 NIXL errors, 0 tracebacks over 4 h.
- Failed requests: 193, all within the 20 minutes around the crashes (aborted in flight, or `Bootstrapping` timeouts while the decodes reloaded); none afterwards. Before this patch the same arm produced ~300/h of 300 s timeout failures after each decode restart.

**Pod delete, new ip** (one decode pod deleted; replacement ready in ~4 min):
- Graceful drain: no aborts, no bootstrap failures, no NIXL errors.
- No eviction, as the identity includes the ip; the old registration lingers unused (documented limitation).

More runs with this change (same logic, in our master-stack image), 2026-11-04:

- Induced decode restart with 8 long requests in flight (1P2D, LIBFABRIC): rooms mid-transfer failed at once instead of waiting out the timeout; when the restarted decode registered, the prefill evicted its 8 old peers on both prefill ranks and served the new ones; 0 `WaitingForInput` timeouts afterwards. Same with both decodes restarted together.
- Re-registration path on a 2-GPU 1P1D rig (Qwen3-0.6B, UCX): decode waiting timeout set to 15 s, prefill scheduler SIGSTOPped for 25 s → the decode timed out and registered again → `registered again; rebuilding its endpoint` → `Rebuilt NIXL peer … in 2 ms`, next requests succeed.
- GSM8K unchanged (97.27% vs 97.35% on the baseline image).

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

+    def _peer_info(self, name, endpoint="127.0.0.1", port=5555, gpu_id=0):

+            dst_port=port,

+    def _make_registering_manager(self):
+        mgr = self._make_manager([])
+        mgr.dcp_size = 1
+        mgr.requires_dcp_relayout = lambda size, rank: False
+        mgr.request_status = {}
+        mgr.transfer_infos = {}
+        mgr.failure_lock = threading.Lock()
+        mgr.failure_records = {}
+        return mgr
+
+    def _room(self, mgr, room, peers, port=5555):
+        mgr.request_status[room] = KVPoll.WaitingForInput
+        mgr.transfer_infos[room] = {
+            name: TransferInfo(
+                room=room,
+                endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+                dst_port=port,
+                agent_name=name,
+                dst_kv_indices=np.array([2], dtype=np.int32),
+                dst_aux_index=0,

+            for name in peers

+    def test_restarted_decode_evicts_the_old_peer_and_fails_its_rooms(self):
+        """A new agent from the same decode ip and GPU rank, under a new
+        agent name and rank port, means the old decode process is gone: its
+        rooms fail now, its metadata is dropped, and the new peer serves
+        later rooms."""
+        mgr = self._make_registering_manager()
+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("old"))
+        self._room(mgr, 41, ["old"])
+        self._room(mgr, 42, ["old"])
+        mgr.request_status[42] = KVPoll.Success
+
+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("new", port=5556))
+
+        self.assertIn("old", mgr._evicted_peers)
+        self.assertFalse(mgr.agent.check_remote_metadata("old"))
+        self.assertTrue(mgr.agent.check_remote_metadata("new"))
+        self.assertEqual(mgr._peer_by_endpoint[("127.0.0.1", 0, 0, 0)], "new")
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.request_status[41], KVPoll.Failed)
+        self.assertIn("replaced", mgr.failure_records[41])
+        # A concluded room is left alone.
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.request_status[42], KVPoll.Success)
+        self.assertNotIn(42, mgr.failure_records)

+        self.assertIn("old", mgr.decode_kv_args_table)
+        mgr._reload_invalidated_peers(

+        )
+        self.assertFalse(mgr.agent.check_remote_metadata("old"))

+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("old"))
+        self.assertFalse(mgr.agent.check_remote_metadata("old"))
+        self.assertEqual(mgr._peer_by_endpoint[("127.0.0.1", 0, 0, 0)], "new")

+    def test_reregistered_peer_is_rebuilt_by_the_worker_before_posting(self):
+        """A decode registers again only after timing out on this rank: the
+        bootstrap thread records it, and the transfer worker rebuilds the
+        endpoint (a new NIXL generation) before the next room posts."""
+        mgr = self._make_registering_manager()
+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("peer"))
+        first_generation = mgr.agent.sections["peer"]
+        first_dlist = mgr.prep_handles["peer"]
+
+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("peer"))
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr._peer_refresh_pending)
+        # Nothing is rebuilt on the bootstrap thread.
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.agent.sections["peer"], first_generation)
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn.time.monotonic", return_value=200.0
+        ):
+            mgr._refresh_reregistered_peers(dict.fromkeys(["peer"]))
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr._peer_refresh_pending)
+        self.assertNotEqual(mgr.agent.sections["peer"], first_generation)
+        self.assertIsNot(mgr.prep_handles["peer"], first_dlist)
+        # Rooms with other peers do not touch the pending entry.
+        mgr._add_remote_peer(self._peer_info("peer"))
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn.time.monotonic", return_value=200.5
+        ):
+            mgr._refresh_reregistered_peers(dict.fromkeys(["other"]))
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr._peer_refresh_pending)
+        handle = mgr.send_kvcache(
+            "peer",
+            np.array([1], dtype=np.int32),
+            mgr.decode_kv_args_table["peer"].dst_kv_ptrs,
+            np.array([2], dtype=np.int32),
+            0,
+            "notif",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(handle, ("peer", mgr.agent.sections["peer"]))

+    def test_transport_error_forces_a_rebuild_of_the_peer_it_names(self):
+        """NIXL may keep a peer's metadata valid after a transport error on a
+        posted handle; the peer the error names is rebuilt anyway, its
+        siblings in the room are not."""
+        mgr = self._make_manager(["peer", "other"])
+        generation = mgr.agent.sections["peer"]
+        other_generation = mgr.agent.sections["other"]
+        room = dict.fromkeys(["peer", "other"])
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn.time.monotonic", return_value=300.0
+        ):
+            mgr._reload_invalidated_peers(room)
+            mgr._reload_invalidated_peers(room, failure=ValueError("peer geometry"))
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.agent.sections["peer"], generation)
+        disconnect = RuntimeError(
+            "postXferReq: remote agent 'peer' was disconnected after transfer "
+            "request creation"
+        )
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn.time.monotonic", return_value=301.5
+        ):
+            mgr._reload_invalidated_peers(room, failure=disconnect)
+        self.assertNotEqual(mgr.agent.sections["peer"], generation)
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.agent.sections["other"], other_generation)
+        self.assertTrue(mgr.agent.check_remote_metadata("peer"))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            NixlKVManager._is_transport_failure(RuntimeError("NIXL_ERR_NOT_FOUND"))
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            NixlKVManager._is_transport_failure(
+                RuntimeError(
+                    "remote agent x was disconnected after transfer request creation"
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(NixlKVManager._is_transport_failure(ValueError("geometry")))

issue_comments.body:
Decode-restart run on the 1P2D EFA deployment (LIBFABRIC backend, shadow traffic) carrying this patch with the GPU-rank-keyed identity:

**Container restart, same ip** (both decode engines died within two minutes of each other, a separate scheduler crash):
- The prefill logged 32 `NIXL peer … was replaced by …; evicting it and failing its rooms` lines when the restarted decodes registered after loading (8 GPUs × 2 prefill ranks × 2 decodes).
- 0 `WaitingForInput` timeouts, 0 NIXL errors, 0 tracebacks over 4 h.
- Failed requests: 193, all within the 20 minutes around the crashes (aborted in flight, or `Bootstrapping` timeouts while the decodes reloaded); none afterwards. Before this patch the same arm produced ~300/h of 300 s timeout failures after each decode restart.

**Pod delete, new ip** (one decode pod deleted; replacement ready in ~4 min):
- Graceful drain: no aborts, no bootstrap failures, no NIXL errors.
- No eviction, as the identity includes the ip; the old registration lingers unused (documented limitation).

More runs with this change (same logic, in our master-stack image), 2026-11-04:

- Induced decode restart with 8 long requests in flight (1P2D, LIBFABRIC): rooms mid-transfer failed at once instead of waiting out the timeout; when the restarted decode registered, the prefill evicted its 8 old peers on both prefill ranks and served the new ones; 0 `WaitingForInput` timeouts afterwards. Same with both decodes restarted together.
- Re-registration path on a 2-GPU 1P1D rig (Qwen3-0.6B, UCX): decode waiting timeout set to 15 s, prefill scheduler SIGSTOPped for 25 s → the decode timed out and registered again → `registered again; rebuilding its endpoint` → `Rebuilt NIXL peer … in 2 ms`, next requests succeed.
- GSM8K unchanged (97.27% vs 97.35% on the baseline image).
